hook.name: OilHook
hook.description: Charges a trade tax on ETH/$OIL swaps in Uniswap v4: buy fees (ETH) go to a treasury, sell fees ($OIL) go to a holder reserve distributor. Includes a launch anti-snipe mechanism with an initially high fee (up to 95%) that decays linearly over time to the 3% normal ceiling; exact-output swaps are blocked during the launch window.
